args.message: For each month of 2025 I took the average order value (total order amount divided by number of orders) and added it to the running sum starting in January 2025. By December 2025 the running sum reaches about 801.19. Monthly averages range from 61.61 (November) to 73.32 (October). All orders are included, including those with status 'bad'.
